summary: Gating oracle suite re-baselined and adjudicated: it is RED. Phase 2 was relaunched from scratch (attempt 1's artifacts failed three of five completeness clauses and were not reusable) and ran to completion on a machine verified quiet before and after: pass 1 FAILED (1 failed, 586 passed, 3 skipped, 4 xfailed; sole failure test_mixed_and_box_next with OracleTimeoutError at 60000ms, identical to attempt 1's verdict) and pass 2 TIMED OUT (exit 124) at its 900s budget, hanging in test_temporal_propositional_interleaving. Phase 3 verdict is rubric category (c), established from the main run alone. No baseline was promoted; the committed partial baselines/oracle-run.txt was not overwritten; nothing was weakened anywhere (git diff --stat -- oracle/bimodal_logic/ is empty). Phase 5's gate repair is complete and verified: Step 3 re-pinned 550->606 with three new per-marker sub-count pins and a partition check (and a latent extractor bug fixed that would have made the sub-count pins check nothing), Step 5 re-scoped from stale line numbers onto content-matched guard checks that FAIL under all four required mutations and pass on the unmodified tree, Step 6 pointed at the gating runner. Phase 6's marker flip was correctly NOT performed (gate requires category (a)/(b)); the category-(c) framing correction was done instead, retiring the false no-pytest-xdist / 550-test / serial-run / contention-kill premises. Two mid-task re-runs were contended by a sibling project's Lean lint job and are recorded as unadjudicable rather than used as evidence — a reporting error I made and corrected. New finding: the repaired gate surfaced a deterministic in-package failure, test_example_cases[BM_CM_1-example_case7], naming the same example case as the oracle-side BM_CM_1 failure. Phases 4 and 7 are blocked on machine quietness.

blockers.description: The gating oracle suite is RED on a verified-quiet machine, and this is the task's honest recorded outcome rather than a process failure. Pass 1 fails test_oracle_interface.py::TestMixedFormulas::test_mixed_and_box_next with OracleTimeoutError (Z3 did not decide within 60000 ms at temporal_depth=1, M=3), reproduced identically across two independent quiet-machine runs. Pass 2 exceeds its 900s budget without completing, hanging in test_soundness_regression.py::TestStateIsolationRegression::test_temporal_propositional_interleaving. No budget, floor, assertion, marker, or guard was changed. Diagnosis is an explicit non-goal of a baselining task and needs a follow-up task.
blockers.resume_point: A follow-up diagnosis task, not a re-run of this plan. See baselines/oracle-baseline-STATUS.md section 'Follow-up required'.

blockers.description: NEW, previously unrecorded in-package failure surfaced by the repaired gate: code/src/model_checker/theory_lib/bimodal/tests/unit/test_bimodal.py::test_example_cases[BM_CM_1-example_case7] fails on BOTH attempts with a fast deterministic 'AssertionError: Test failed for example: BM_CM_1' (not a timeout, so the documented Z3-flake retry does not absorb it). It names the same example case as the oracle-side test_regression_all_active_examples[BM_CM_1-example_case7] and is very likely the same defect with a far better handle on it. This is why verify-refactor.sh --skip-oracle exits 1: Steps 4 and 7 fail, both untouched by this task. Not repaired here (fixing a defect found during triage is an explicit non-goal).
blockers.resume_point: Spawn a diagnosis task for BM_CM_1/example_case7 starting from the in-package test, which is deterministic and budget-independent.

blockers.description: Phases 4 (exhaustive-scan coverage record, 60-90 min serial) and 7 (independent verify-refactor.sh run with Step 6 live, 25-40 min) were not started because the machine was not quiet: a sibling project's Lean toolchain was consuming 168-216% CPU when they came due, and up to 776% earlier in the session. The plan mandates stopping rather than running contended, since every result obtained under contention is unadjudicable. This is an environmental blocker, not a technical one.
